shared_elements: horizontal band or register of decoration
repeated short linear marks or chevrons
justification: The strongest correspondence is that both are upright carved stone surfaces organized at least partly by horizontal bands, with animal or bird-like motifs rendered in shallow relief/incision. The biggest difference is that A is densely divided into many small registers filled with fine, crowded linear figures, whereas B uses a few large, bold animal forms spread across a much more open surface.
